principle: Do not delete ancestry to make a better version; make the next version from accumulated ancestry.

historical_layer_rule: These modules are not deleted or rewritten merely to satisfy wording. Their data/behavior remains ancestry; when they participate in canonical evolution, the spiral control plane must preserve identity/lesson lineage around them.

audit_rules: No canonical evolution path may mark a learning species extinct.
No failed candidate may vanish without a lesson/receipt.
No Scout turn may reuse an identity as if it were a fresh reset.
No bounded active frontier may imply deleted provenance.
No previous model output may bootstrap itself into independent evidence.
